Subject: Trial governance & decision pathways — proposed owners and next steps

Hi Sara / Matt —

Great to meet yesterday — thanks again for the time. As promised, below is a short recap of what we discussed and a proposed ownership/decision pathway to get the trial moving the week of Oct 11. I attached a concise POC checklist and a draft short-form SLA for procurement.

Recap & success criteria (customer-defined):
- End-to-end inference in their staging environment, serving 95th-percentile inference latency under 250ms for typical payloads (avg seq len ~120 tokens)
- ≥ 95% functional parity with current baseline on our validation prompt set (we'll share the eval harness)
- Cost-per-1000-tokens target for production projection (for procurement alignment)

Proposed trial scope and timeline:
- Oct 11: kickoff (internal owners identified, access granted)
- Oct 12–16: infra onboarding + model variant tuning in staging (continuous eval)
- Oct 19–23: integration & runbook handover; run sample production traffic slice
- Oct 26: joint review & decision (go/no-go / next steps)

Ownership / decision pathways (proposal) — quick matrix:
- Executive sponsor (customer): Matt Olsen — final signoff on trial scope and procurement
- Infra & network (customer): Evelyn infra team — provide VPC peering or allowlist; Redwood infra onboarding lead: Karthik Iyer (redwood)
- App integration (customer): Sara Tan — feature owners and API integration testing
- Security/compliance evidence: Evelyn security lead to request SOC2/SIEM details; Redwood point for evidence: Monica Patel (redwood)
- Success criteria & evaluation: Redwood CS lead: Marissa Cole; Customer QA: Sara

Decisions needed from your side before kickoff:
1) Confirm owners above (Matt, Sara, Evelyn infra + security contact emails)
2) Confirm whether the trial will run in your VPC (preferred) or in Redwood-hosted sandbox (we can run either)
3) Any legal/procurement constraints we should be aware of for the short-form SLA

Attachments: Redwood-POC-checklist.xlsx (summary onboarding steps), POC-SLA-draft.pdf (one-page draft for review).

If this looks good I can schedule a 30-minute kickoff on Oct 11 — please share 2 windows that day or confirm who will own scheduling on your side.

Thanks,
Rishi
